mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Chronoshift</titleLeft><mainText>Upon taking lethal damage, this unit will instead be reverted in time to before they took lethal damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for @RDuration@ seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for @ReviveStateDuration@ seconds, then reviving them and restoring <healing>@RTotalHeal@ Health</healing>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_HeightenedLearning_Tooltip}}

Total awarded: @TotalXP@ Experience.

Experience can't be granted in combat.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Time Warp</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is dramatically increased.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zilean <status>Slows</status> an enemy champion by @Effect2Amount@% or grants an allied champion <speed>@Effect2Amount@% Move Speed</speed> for @Effect1Amount@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Time Bomb</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has a bomb attached to them. The bomb will detonate soon, dealing damage to surrounding units.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After @Effect2Amount@ seconds it detonates, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for @Effect4Amount@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The bomb will prioritize attaching to champions and units that already have a bomb.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by @Effect2Amount@ seconds.
